events.event_name: The Dewy Day Tour: YEPODA K-Beauty Pop-Up at Sephora Union Square
events.what_it_is: A Yepoda K-beauty pop-up at Sephora Union Square with product trials, giveaways and chances to win Sephora gift cards and full-size products.
events.what_is_free: Attendance and advertised freebies are free with no purchase necessary; gifts are while supplies last. Separate gifts-with-purchase are available at stated Sephora purchase thresholds.
events.caveats: Free gifts are while supplies last. A separate gift-with-purchase offer requires a qualifying Sephora purchase, but purchase is explicitly not required to attend or receive the general freebies. No advance RSVP requirement was established by the current event listing.
events.practical_notes: Sunday Sept. 20, 12–6 PM. The listing identifies Sephora Union Square at 40 E 14th St and also describes the activation on Broadway between E 13th and E 14th Streets.

events.event_name: PlanetHAUS NYC Climate Week Immersive Experience
events.what_it_is: A two-day Climate Week immersive sustainable-home experience at Chief Clubhouse with 70+ participating brands, room-by-room activations, product sampling, a Gifting Garden and stage programming.
events.what_is_free: Registration is free. The daytime experience advertises product sampling and PlanetHAUS' Gifting Garden alongside talks and brand activations.
events.caveats: Free registration is required and a current Climate/UNGA event-map listing explicitly classifies access as organizer approval required. Do not treat submission of the registration as confirmed admission. Separate after-hours PlanetHAUS programs may require separate registration and are not included in these daytime occurrences.
events.practical_notes: Sept. 21 and Sept. 22 at Chief Clubhouse, 13 E 19th St. Current organizer/host listings describe daytime access as 8:30 AM–4 PM; the official Climate Week calendar lists the Sept. 21 program beginning at 9 AM, so arriving at/after 9 AM is the conservative public-facing interpretation unless the registration confirmation specifies otherwise.

occurrences.details: Walk-in public pop-up. No purchase necessary to attend or receive the advertised general freebies; gifts are while supplies last.

occurrences.hours: 8:30 AM–4 PM (official Climate Week calendar lists 9 AM start)
occurrences.details: Free registration; organizer approval required. Registration covers the daytime PlanetHAUS program.
Free registration; organizer approval required. Separate Sept. 22 after-hours programs are not included in this occurrence.
